name: Fold-free spherical 3R whose J2 is a link-1 arc-rail sector with a link-2 roller carriage (no J2 hub; virtual J2 axis)
lens: round3:J2 as a short curved rail with a real carriage, on a fold-free axis layout
verdict: screening (coarse 268 on the farm); CMA streams running
limiter: the J2 rail is a body of revolution about p2: one level over J2's whole travel (~150 deg incl. carriage, stops, tab); in band max 0.03 over 49 honest configs, level 72-140 mm (65 % never clear the skin); link 2 inherits that level (max 0.26)
note: Bench(60,160) fast, kit checks (march, dense K2, K6, audit) + crown/top skin checks; hub control at identical axes 57.75 vs rail 71.12 (local re-run)

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R with J2 as a conical arc-rail sector on link 1 and a V-roller carriage on link 2. bodies: link 1 + rail sector, carriage + link 2, arm-end (hub-3 plate + K7 neck). joints: J1, J3 O20 hubs, J2 carriage on the arc rail (4 x MR63ZZ V-rollers, preloaded on 2 eccentric pins). custom: base, link 1, rail sector (lathe-turned), carriage plate, link 2, neck, 4 roller pins, 2 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 2 x MR117 pair + 4 MR63ZZ (est.).
